_: What this user knows through their xstream interactions. Built up through engagement. If it is not here, the system has not yet registered it. Organised by category.

1._: People. Who the user has encountered or been told about through xstream.

2._: Topics. What subjects have come up, what territory has been explored.

3._: Events. What has happened during xstream sessions — commitments, exchanges, outcomes.

4._: Connections. Links discovered between topics, people, ideas.

5._: Outputs. Things produced — texts, decisions, proposals, designs.

6._: Context. Real-world context the user has provided about themselves and their situation.
